name: Harbor
label: Harbor · low, calm male
description: A man in his fifties with a low, even voice and a slight gravel at the bottom of it. Unhurried, warm, the kind of voice that reads the shipping forecast: every word placed, nothing rushed, a small smile audible now and then.
style: Calm and unhurried. Pause at commas. Never raise the voice.
refText: The tide turns just after midnight tonight. If you're heading out, take the long way round the point; the short cut dries at low water and you'll be waiting for the sea to come back.
author: Shell:B
